observations.title: Test harness uses eval to load source file
observations.technical_explanation: Using eval to load a sibling source file works but is fragile and prevents static analysis. Converting the loaded file to a module or using a test loader would be cleaner, though it is not a security issue because the evaluated content is a fixed local project file with no attacker-controlled input.
observations.layman_explanation: The tests load a project file in a slightly old-fashioned way. It is not dangerous, but a more standard module-loading approach would be easier to maintain.
observations.developer_action: Consider loading the source file as a module or via a test harness instead of eval for maintainability; no security change is required.
